name: SIMMTECH Co., Ltd.
summary: SIMMTECH Co., Ltd. engages in the development and manufacture of high-layer printed circuit boards (PCBs) for semiconductors worldwide. The company offers solid state drive module PCBs for notebook and desktop PC, server, computer, etc.; memory module PCBs, such as dual inline memory module (DIMM), small outline DIMM, and registered DIMM for desktop PC, notebook PC, workstation, server, etc.; multi-layer module PCBs for server, supercomputer, etc.; and automotive boards for engine control units, connectivity boards, and ADAS.
